purpose: P6-E calibration half: compare training-member clean candidates with fresh clean test queries under the same frozen score direction and validation calibration

victims.checkpoint_policy: load and hash-check archived clean and suspect checkpoints; never retrain

views.suspect_hidden64: suspect checkpoint hidden64; no trusted clean checkpoint needed
views.paired_hidden64_drift: suspect hidden64 minus archived clean hidden64; explicit oracle-clean-checkpoint counterfactual

score.candidate_scope: all training candidates assigned to target class 6
score.cross_fit: queries in candidate fold A use the unit mean-shift direction estimated from fold B and conversely
score.reference: 96 clean validation rows with true class 6
score.calibration: 96 different clean validation rows with true class 6
score.reference_calibration_rng_seed: 20280929 + victim_seed; shuffle target-class validation indices, use first 96 as reference and next 96 as calibration
score.fresh_query: all 666 true-class-6 test rows, assigned to score folds by a permutation from default_rng(20300929 + victim_seed) and an alternating fold allocation
score.member_query: all 2330 original true-class-6 clean training rows; their candidate-fold membership determines the opposite direction used for scoring
score.raw_score: inner product of (feature minus reference mean) with the cross-fitted unit direction
score.rank_pvalue: (1 + number of same-fold calibration scores greater than or equal to the query score) / 97
forbidden: no poison truth in direction, score, threshold, or expansion decisions
no seed-specific representation, split, sign, threshold, or calibration-size tuning
no use of fresh test queries in direction or calibration fitting

development_gate.expansion_rule: run all five confirmation seeds only if every non-performance gate passes on both development seeds

reported_outputs: victim balanced CA and ASR replay
per-view and per-seed member-clean FPR, fresh-test FPR, gap, calibration KS statistics, and exact counts
per-query source split, source index, fold, raw score, rank p-value, and flag
pooled population rates and seed-level ranges without performance-based selection

interpretation.fresh_query: empirical calibration check where queries do not train either checkpoint or direction; official dataset splits may still differ, so exact exchangeability is an assumption rather than a proven fact
interpretation.member_query: membership-dependent screening condition; validation calibration is not automatically exchangeable because member queries trained the suspect checkpoint
interpretation.allowed_claim: report the measured membership/calibration shift by view and seed; do not call member-candidate rank p-values exact conformal inference
